events.excerpt: A story loosely based on Gerd Prokop’s work about sleep, for all alert children aged 3 and over.

events.name: WUSEL UND DER GOLDENE RING – Theater Katinchen
events.excerpt: In the second instalment of the trilogy, Wusel and Morella finally find out what the golden ring is all about. Grabor the mole plays a crucial role, and Tilly the squirrel is also keenly involved this time.

events.name: Family Sunday
events.excerpt: On seven Family Sundays, the JMB invites families with children aged between six and sixteen to join in discovery tours.

events.name: A belly full of courage
events.excerpt: A wolf howls at the full moon at night. Nobody knows why. Perhaps he’s got a tummy ache. A goose lives comfortably in a dark cave. She’s got everything she needs. It’s just that it’s a bit lonely in there.

events.name: Of Crocodiles and Dinosaur Claws
events.excerpt: Every October, Children’s Culture Month offers children and families a unique programme of hands-on activities and experiences.

events.name: A Journey of Discovery Through the Mongol Empire
events.excerpt: How do you survive on the Mongolian steppe? Why was a city built there 800 years ago? And who exactly was Genghis Khan?

events.name: Three Stones for the Soup – Theater auf dem Bügelbrett
events.excerpt: A traveller arrives in the village and asks for something to eat. He knocks on every door, but nobody gives him anything. Everyone has barely enough for themselves. “There’s only one thing left for me to do,” says the man.

events.name: All Ages Karaoke
events.excerpt: Karaoke for the whole family!

events.name: Family Tour
events.excerpt: The Berlinische Galerie invites you to join its Family Tour. On this guided tour, you can experience the exhibition ‘Lovis Corinth. Then came Berlin!’ in a fun and interactive way.

events.name: Of ghosts and spirits
events.excerpt: Waldemar, the castle ghost, is back! Fall is spooky season—at least that’s what Waldemar thinks. And that’s why, together with his assistant Astrid Heiland-Vondruska, he’s telling his favorite ghost stories at the castle.

events.name: Paper Mask Creatures
events.excerpt: A wild animal, a funny monster or a creature that nobody has ever seen before? You’ll create your own mask from a simple paper template. With beaks, ears, horns or noses, you can bring imaginative characters to life.

events.name: The Carnival of the Animals
events.excerpt: A musical journey through the animal kingdom that will enchant young and old alike: with clowning, masks and a light-hearted touch, these two brilliant pianists and ‘sound clowns’ bring Camille Saint-Saëns’ famous melodies to life.

events.name: LAUTSTÄRKER · Final Presentation
events.excerpt: LAUTSTÄRKER is the final presentation of the youth project of the same name. Young people from Lichtenberg will perform an extraordinary live musical album on stage.

events.name: People, PEOPLE!
events.excerpt: Nothing is infinite; only two things seem to be: the universe and the social media feed. A crew of space-faring dinosaurs explores the vastness of social media. This gives rise to many insights, many questions and even more speculation.

events.name: Power Posters for Berlin
events.excerpt: Creative leisure activities for children: How do you get your messages, wishes and demands across to people in the city and in your local area without going online?

events.name: Stop-motion workshop
events.excerpt: Learn how to make your own little LEGO® film using the Stop Motion Studio app!

events.name: Spooky wildlife at Berlin Zoo
events.excerpt: As we all know, October is the spookiest month of the year. Even the zoo’s animal residents have a few secrets that are almost eerie.

events.name: Hands-on afternoon with Aunt Milli Tausendgrün
events.excerpt: Short stories, big imaginations! Together, you’ll discover enchanting picture books, immerse yourselves in exciting stories and then let your creativity run wild.

events.name: Autumn break course
events.excerpt: Have you always wanted to learn how to draw a portrait or a self-portrait?

events.name: Glowing Paper Balls
events.excerpt: Make paper glow! You’ll tear and layer thin, translucent sheets of paper around a balloon. As you do so, you can incorporate colourful shapes, patterns and small paper motifs directly into the covering.

events.name: Our City, Our History!
events.excerpt: Holiday programme for children: On this course, after-school groups explore the permanent exhibition, discover Berlin from different perspectives and tell their own stories about Berlin.

events.name: The Wolf and the Seven Little Goats
events.excerpt: Something’s not quite right at Bert’s bookshop. His books seem to be taking on a life of their own. And suddenly, everyone finds themselves caught up in the Brothers Grimm’s favourite game of hide-and-seek.

events.name: My Berlin
events.excerpt: What made Berlin so special 100 years ago? What fascinated artists about this fast-paced metropolis, and which people shaped the city?

events.name: Spooky Fun: Ghostly Tales – We make up spooky stories
events.excerpt: Story workshop for children aged 7 to 12.

events.name: Escape Game (Trainee Weeks)
events.excerpt: Why does the special edition of a new bestseller go missing the day before the exhibition? Can you track down the culprit and find the book before it is destroyed?

events.name: F(Olha)/Um(Blättern)
events.excerpt: An interactive dance piece about falling leaves, change and new beginnings.

events.name: Triangle meets circle
events.excerpt: Craft workshop as part of the exhibition ‘KUNSTKNALL – Girl Power in Art’.

events.name: Mr. Eichhorn and the First Snow
events.excerpt: About searching, finding, and staying awake. “Winter,” says the goat, “is beautiful. Snowflakes fall from the sky and everything turns white! Mr. Eichhorn has always slept through winter….”

events.name: Spooky Fun: Ghostly Tales – We make up spooky stories
events.excerpt: Story workshop for children aged 7 to 12. Together with author and literary educator Anja Frisch, you’ll invent and create your very own spooky stories.

events.name: Halloween with Paper: Spooky Paper Masks
events.excerpt: At Halloween, paper becomes the starting point for spooky, imaginative and surprising creations. Together, we’ll make little Halloween creations such as ghosts, bats, spider’s webs, pumpkins and other creepy paper figures.

events.name: DIY Hands-On Wednesday: Werewolves of Düsterwald
events.excerpt: Things are set to get exciting at the library this October: who’s the werewolf, who’s a villager – and who can you still trust?
